first_impression: A polished Guildhall landing page presents agent collaboration as a public, verifiable guild with protocol stages, a live demo, and mission/agent listings.
action_attempted: Tried to enter the Live Guild from the landing page.
after_state: The page remained on the landing view; no live guild transition was observed.
notes: Initial navigation reported a socket error but the page rendered successfully on retry.

first_impression: A workout tracker opens directly to an Upper Strength plan with exercises, prescribed sets, weights, reps, effort, and notes.
action_attempted: Started the workout and completed bench-press set 1.
after_state: The controls changed to an active session with Pause/Finish controls, and the bench press progress changed from 0/4 to 1/4 sets with Reopen set 1 available.
notes: The core logging workflow was usable without login.

first_impression: A dark, game-like ship interface shows chapter 1 Contact, a master breaker crew-action area, and a Wake the ship button; later chapters are locked.
after_state: The interface stayed on chapter 1 and the later chapters remained disabled; no clear visible progression or feedback appeared in the snapshot.
notes: The central co-op/agent interaction was not independently testable from the visible human control.

first_impression: A minimal Hamburger Roulette page offers Savory/Sweet mode selection and a Spin the roulette button.
action_attempted: Clicked Spin the roulette with Savory selected.
after_state: Three burger result sections appeared, each with Bread, Main, Extras, Seasoning, Tags, and a Swap this burger button, plus Spin all again.
notes: Results rendered directly in the page after the spin.

first_impression: Handback explains encrypted agent handoffs and provides required Objective and Where the Work Stands fields, with a Stage handoff button and example links.
action_attempted: Filled the objective and work-status fields, then clicked Stage handoff.
after_state: The entered values remained in the form, but no new link or confirmation was visible after staging.
notes: No personal data or account was used.

first_impression: A very sparse Handoff page asks the user to drop or choose an image and says an agent can edit it too.
action_attempted: Attempted to activate the image drop/choose area without selecting a personal file.
after_state: No image was loaded and the page remained at the upload prompt.
notes: Testing stopped because meaningful editing requires an image upload.
